scalarAdditions.description: Neko-TOP additions to Neko's open scalar object (`case.scalar` and the items of `case.scalars`).

scalarOptimizing.description: Restrictions on `case.scalar` while the adjoint scalar is enabled.
scalarOptimizing.$comment: adjoint_scalar_scheme.f90:355-358 aborts when `variable_material_properties` is present. `variable_material_properties` is what the adjoint guards, and Neko no longer reads it. `Pe`, `lambda` and `cp` go through the constants lookup (:610-637), like Neko's own, so Neko's definitions apply.

scalarForward.description: Restrictions on an enabled `case.scalar` of a case with an `optimization` object.
scalarForward.$comment: neko_ext.f90:236-238 reads the scalar initial condition type at every design iteration, with no default and even with `restart_file`.
